corrections.message: The CLI hands text to a shell. Registry entries, file content and transcripts are untrusted data and must never be executed.
corrections.fix: Express the check as data (regex or glob). If a process is unavoidable, pass a fixed argv list to subprocess.run, never a shell string.
corrections.why: Safety requirement: never execute untrusted transcript or instruction text as code.

corrections.message: Dynamic code execution in the CLI turns any text it reads into a possible program.
corrections.fix: Parse the input as data (json, re) and act on the parsed value; do not evaluate it.
corrections.why: Safety requirement: never execute untrusted transcript or instruction text as code.

corrections.message: Third-party import. The core must run on a bare Python 3 with no package registry, Node, or agent runtime.
corrections.fix: Use the standard library (json, re, argparse, unittest), or drop the feature that needs the dependency.

corrections.message: A test names a real path under /workspace. Tests may only touch throwaway projects in the system temp dir.
corrections.fix: Build the project under the ProjectCase temp dir (self.project / self.tmp) and reach this repo only through support.REPO.
corrections.why: Requirement: tests must never use a real user repo.

corrections.message: Code touches user-global or system git configuration.
corrections.fix: Scope the setting to the one repo (git -C <repo> config --local ...) or pass it per command with -c.
